scope: Explicit full RTX4090 opt-in causal scheduling at B1 H16 S1024/4096 D64/128; dense geometry unchanged; no default dispatch change
precision: Existing single-rounded input-dtype P before dS, input-dtype dS, FP32 products/actual-O delta, late dQ/dK scale; FA2 and SDPA use their own policies

fa2.layout_adapter: BHSD views to BSHD and back

selection.shape_boundaries: Inherited explicit RTX4090 entry only; ordinary CuTe handles masks, GQA, tails, other dimensions and devices

graph_protocol.layout: BHSD API boundary; FA receives BSHD views and returns a BHSD view, including any backend preparation
graph_protocol.timing: warmed CUDA-graph device events; rotate backend order; no profiling during timing
graph_protocol.precision: CuTe single-rounded P/dS, FP32 accumulation and actual-O delta; standalone FA retains its own arithmetic policy

eager_protocol: Warmed alternating CUDA-event/device and synchronized host complete calls, seven windows of twenty calls; backward excludes saved forward; no profiler instrumentation
limitations: Only the bounded explicit RTX4090 path is selected; no transfer claim for other SM89 devices.
Graph and eager results have separate timing boundaries.
Compute counters denied by host permissions; no stall/cache percentage claim.
Ordering also changes compiler address/iterator code and register allocation; same arithmetic does not imply identical SASS.
